line: **Saluva titles:** the original family name is unknown; Narasimha's predecessors used **Katarisaluva** and **Pratipaksaluva** – his great-grandfather **Mangiraja** held **Pratipaksaluva**; descendants of the clan from Kalyana bore **Kalyanapuravaradhiswara**.

**Chevvappa (Sevappa) Nayaka:** appointed ruler of **Thanjavur** by **Achyutaraya** in **1535 AD** (ruled 1535-1561); married **Murthamamba**, sister of Achyutaraya's queen; Thanjavur stayed **loyal to Vijayanagara** and was a fierce rival of **Madurai**.

mcq.s: Who appointed Chevvappa (Sevappa) Nayaka as the ruler of Thanjavur in 1535 AD?
mcq.x: Achyutaraya appointed Chevvappa in 1535; Chevvappa married Murthamamba, sister of Achyutaraya's queen.

line: **Influences on Venkataratnam Naidu:** Brahmo Samaj members **Dinanath Banerjee** and **Gangadhar Mukherji** of Bengal, and **Dr. Miller**, principal of **Madras Christian College**, where he took his BA, MA and LLB.

**Nellore, 1207-08:** Kakatiya (Ganapatideva's) forces invaded the Nellore Telugu Chola kingdom, defeated **Tammasiddhi** and handed the throne to **Thikkabhupala** (Tikka, father of Manumasiddhi), then marched on **Kanchi**.
**Venkataramana Charyulu / Rangacharyulu:** encouraged **widow remarriages in Visakhapatnam** and wrote a book titled **"Widow Remarriages"**.
**Nagarjuna's "theory of relativity":** introduced by Acharya Nagarjuna to explain the **relationships between substances** in the world; he also built a large **library at Sriparvatam**.
**Beta Raju I:** son of **Gundyana**; called the **Vamsakartha** of the Kakatiyas; title **Kakati Puradhinatha**; his son Prola Raju bore **Kakati Vallabha**.

mcq.s: Which Kakatiya ruler held the title 'Kakati Puradhinatha'?
mcq.x: Beta Raju I, son of Gundyana and Vamsakartha of the Kakatiyas, bore the title Kakati Puradhinatha; Kakati Vallabha was Prola Raju's title.

line: **Kakatipuram:** the title **Kakatipuravallabha** (Bayyaram inscription period) links the clan name to **Kakatipuram**, likely after its **Kakatamma (Kakitamma) temple**; Eriya Rashtrakuta ruled **Korivi Mandal** from **Orugallu Kakathipuram**.

**Succession after Venkatapati II:** he named **Srirangaraya** successor; queen **Bayamma's adoption of a Brahmin boy** led to conspiracies led by her brother **Gobbur Jaggaraju**; **Velugoti Yachamanayaka** backed Srirangaraya and Jaggaraju was finally defeated.

**Mir Momin Astarabadi:** Peshwa under **Sultan Muhammad Qutb Shah**; wrote **"Risala-e-Miqdaria"** on **weights and measurements**; Hakim Taqiuddin wrote **"Mizanul Tabai Qutub Shahi"** (medicine) in the same reign.

mcq.s: 'Risala-e-Miqdaria', a work on weights and measurements, was written by
mcq.x: Mir Momin Astarabadi, Peshwa of Sultan Muhammad Qutb Shah, wrote Risala-e-Miqdaria; Hakim Taqiuddin wrote Mizanul Tabai Qutub Shahi.

line: **Mulk Raj Anand:** wrote **"Untouchable"** and **"Coolie"** – listed among the notable books on communism with Sri Sri's Mahaprastanam, Gorky's The Mother and P. Sundaraiah's Veera Telangana.

mcq.s: The novels 'Untouchable' and 'Coolie' were written by
mcq.x: Both Untouchable and Coolie are by Mulk Raj Anand.

line: **Chilakamarthi Lakshmi Narasimham:** founded **Manorama (1906)** and **Desamata (1910)**; Manoranjani (1910) was founded by **Kallakuri Narayana Rao**.
**Vaijana Dandanatha:** minister of **Beta Raju II**, whose titles were **Tribhuvanamalla** and **Vikrama Chakri**.
